name: Market entry strategy
benefit: From market evaluation to measurable success.
body: Entering a new market is a strategic decision — and success begins with the right foundation.

At Nordiska Solutions, we provide comprehensive market assessments, competitive analysis, and phased entry roadmaps tailored to your technology, resources, and growth ambitions. Before operations begin, evaluation is critical. We help you understand market dynamics, customer demand, regulatory frameworks, and competitive positioning — so you can move forward with clarity and confidence.

Our flexible service modules are customized to your stage of internationalization, whether you are exploring opportunities or ready to execute. Finding the right channel partners is only the first step. The real challenge is activating those partnerships and ensuring business flows effectively through them.

With proven tools, structured processes, and years of experience across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East, we support your successful market entry and expansion. Professional channel management strengthens your competitiveness, shortens time-to-market, and enhances financial performance.

And our work doesn’t stop at entry. As your presence grows, we help evaluate partner performance, optimize sector coverage, and identify opportunities to expand operations within your target markets. Together, we transform your initial market entry into a strong, scalable, and sustainable pillar of your global growth strategy.
includes: Customer demand, regulatory context and market fit
Entry options and a phased expansion roadmap
Channel coverage and partner performance review
audience: For technology companies evaluating new markets or refining an existing international presence.
steps: Understand your technology, resources and growth objectives.
Assess demand, competitors, routes to market and practical constraints.
Agree a phased roadmap and priorities for the next stage.

name: Go-to-market strategy
benefit: Turn market potential into commercial success.
body: Entering a new market requires more than ambition — it demands a clear, actionable plan.

At Nordiska Solutions, we design tailored go-to-market strategies that position your company for strong and sustainable entry into your chosen market. We work closely with you to define the optimal mode of entry, identify the right channels and partners, and establish clear budgets, timelines, and measurable KPIs.

Our recommendations are grounded in decades of real-world experience across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East. We assess your desired market positioning, analyze competitive dynamics, and evaluate channel structures and margin potential — ensuring your strategy is both commercially viable and strategically sound.
The result is a structured, data-driven roadmap that reduces risk, accelerates market penetration, and maximizes your return on investment.
With the right go-to-market strategy, you don’t just enter a market — you enter with purpose, precision, and competitive advantage.
includes: Practical KPIs and measures of progress
audience: For companies that have chosen a target market and need an actionable commercial launch plan.
steps: Translate market insight into a clear customer proposition.
Define channels, partners, responsibilities and launch resources.
Set priorities, milestones and a framework for measuring progress.

name: Channel development & partner search
benefit: Find the right partners. Build the right channels.
body: Identifying and securing the right business partners in international markets can be complex, costly, and time-consuming. The real question is not just where to start — but how to find partners who are aligned with your vision and capable of delivering results.

Nordiska Solutions specializes in strategic partner search and channel development across Southeast Asia, Korea, Japan, Saudi Arabia (KSA), the UAE, and Qatar. We help you efficiently identify, assess, and recruit qualified distributors, agents, EPC contractors, and strategic partners who have a genuine interest in collaborating with companies like yours.

Our structured methodology ensures that potential partners are carefully screened and evaluated based on capability, market reach, financial strength, and long-term compatibility. Where discretion is required, confidentiality is treated as paramount. Alternatively, if your objective is to actively position your company within a specific industry as seeking representation, we manage that process professionally and strategically.

Finding a partner is only the beginning. We focus on building sustainable channel structures that generate consistent business flow and long-term growth. Backed by real-world experience and proven systems, we help you secure the right partners — and turn those partnerships into measurable market success.
To explore how we can support your channel development strategy, contact Nordiska Solutions
includes: Distributor, agent and EPC partner identification
Screening for capability, reach and commercial alignment
Channel structure and partner activation planning
audience: For businesses seeking qualified commercial partners, buyers or project collaborators in international markets.
steps: Define your ideal partner and the intended commercial relationship.
Identify and evaluate candidates against agreed criteria.
Support introductions and prepare the next steps for activation.

name: Channel sales ramp-up support
body: Securing the right partners is only the first step. The real impact comes when those partnerships start delivering consistent, measurable sales results.

Nordiska Solutions works closely with you and your in-market partners to accelerate sales performance and ensure momentum from day one. We act as a strategic bridge between yourregional office and local sales teams — aligning objectives, strengthening communication, and ensuring execution stays on track.

From sales readiness and product positioning to pipeline activation and performance monitoring, we support the practical implementation of agreed sales plans. We facilitate transparent information flow, coordinated activities, and clear accountability — so nothing is lost between strategy and execution.
The outcome? Faster ramp-up, stronger channel engagement, and sustained revenue growth in your target markets.
includes: Coordination between regional and local teams
audience: For companies with appointed partners that need practical support to activate and develop their sales channels.
steps: Align objectives, responsibilities and sales plans with your partners.
Support market activity and coordinated opportunity development.
Review progress and adapt priorities with your team.

name: Brand visibility & market activation
benefit: Make your presence seen. Make your impact felt.
body: Entering a new market is not only about having the right product — it’s about being visible, credible, and trusted.

Nordiska Solutions strengthens your market presence through targeted trade exhibitions, focused seminars, industry forums, and curated networking events that place you directly in front of decision-makers and qualified buyers. We ensure your brand is positioned strategically within the right sectors, industries, and conversations.

Beyond participation, we activate markets. Through structured engagement plans and coordinated communication efforts, we help transform visibility into meaningful dialogue — and dialogue into commercial opportunity.

By combining strategic insight with hands-on execution, we build a strong and credible market footprint for your business, laying the foundation for sustainable, long-term growth across the dynamic and fast-growing ASEAN region.
includes: Trade exhibitions, seminars and industry forums
Structured follow-up from interest to opportunity
audience: For technology providers building credibility and starting commercial conversations in a new market.
steps: Identify priority audiences and define a relevant market message.
Plan targeted events, outreach and stakeholder engagement.
Coordinate follow-up and develop the strongest opportunities.

name: Application consultancy
benefit: Connect your technology with the right application.
body: A promising technology creates value when it fits the needs of a real application. We help technology providers and project stakeholders understand requirements, compare options and connect technical decisions with commercial priorities.

Working alongside your technical team, we review process needs, operating conditions and project expectations. The scope is agreed around your technology and the application, with specialist input coordinated where needed.
includes: Coordination of technical and commercial stakeholders
Clear next steps for project and partner discussions
audience: For cleantech providers assessing project fit, and stakeholders seeking suitable technology partners.
steps: Clarify the application, requirements and available information.
Review technology fit with the responsible technical specialists.
Document considerations and coordinate the next discussion.

name: On-site training
benefit: Give local teams the confidence to succeed.
body: Effective market support starts with people who understand the technology and its value. We help prepare partners, customer teams and local personnel with practical training tailored to their roles.

Programme content and delivery are agreed with your team. Sessions can address product knowledge, application understanding, customer conversations and the coordination needed to support local operations.
audience: For businesses preparing distributors, local sales teams or customers to represent and support their technology.
steps: Agree the audience, learning objectives and delivery location.
Prepare a programme with your product and application specialists.
Deliver practical sessions and agree follow-up needs.

name: Aftersales services
benefit: Keep building beyond the first sale.
body: Long-term growth depends on the quality of the relationship after a sale. We help coordinate communication between technology providers, partners and customers so that local needs reach the right people.
Support is scoped to your technology, market and existing service arrangements. We agree responsibilities, escalation routes and practical follow-up with your team before work begins.
includes: Issue routing to the responsible technical team
audience: For companies developing lasting customer relationships and coordinating support across international markets.
steps: Agree the support scope and responsible contacts.
Establish communication and escalation arrangements.
Coordinate follow-up and review recurring support needs.
